# Creator Economy

> > A resource for product managers and creators navigating AI product development, career growth, and the evolving creator economy.

Creator Economy features insights from product leaders at OpenAI, Adobe, Notion, Google, and Amplitude on building AI products, along with practical tutorials on AI agents, workflow automation, and career development strategies. The site also offers a comprehensive PM course through Maven and covers topics like value proposition design, time management, and creator tools.

## Key Topics

- AI Agents & Automation
- Product Management
- AI Product Development
- Career Development
- OpenAI & ChatGPT
- Notion AI
- Google Gemini
- Claude AI
- Product Leadership
- Creator Tools & Strategy
- Value Proposition Design
- Workflow Automation
- LLMs & Neural Networks
- Maven Courses
- PM Career Advice

## AI Product Development & Leadership

- [OpenAI Product Leader: The 4D Method to Build AI Products That Users Actually Want](https://creatoreconomy.so/p/openai-product-leader-the-4d-method-to-build-ai-products-miqdad): OpenAI's Miqdad Jaffer shares 4D framework for AI product development
- [Scott Belsky (CPO Adobe): Collapsing the Talent Stack and the 4P Framework for Building AI Products](https://creatoreconomy.so/p/scott-belsky-collapsing-the-talent-stack-with-ai): Adobe CPO Scott Belsky on 4P framework & AI's impact on talent structure
- [Is This the First AI Analyst That Actually Works? | James Evans (Amplitude)](https://creatoreconomy.so/p/is-this-the-first-ai-analyst-that-actually-works-amplitude-james-evans): Amplitude's James Evans demos AI agents for product analytics automation
- [Inside Suno, the AI Music App You Won't Be Able to Stop Listening To | Mikey Shulman (Suno)](https://creatoreconomy.so/p/inside-suno-the-ai-music-app-you-wont-stop-listening-to-product): Suno's Mikey Shulman explains music LLMs & AI product development strategy
- [ChatGPT vs Claude vs Gemini: The Best AI Model for Each Use Case in 2025](https://creatoreconomy.so/p/chatgpt-vs-claude-vs-gemini-the-best-ai-model-for-each-use-case-2025): Comparison of ChatGPT, Claude & Gemini for coding, writing & multimodal tasks

## AI Agents & Automation Tutorials

- [Notion's New AI Agents for Work Blew Me Away (Full Tutorial) | Akshay & Ryan](https://creatoreconomy.so/p/how-notion-built-the-best-ai-agents-for-work-akshay-ryan): Notion's Akshay Kothari & Ryan Nystrom demo AI agents with Slack integration
- [From Idea to Product in 30 Min Using AI Agents (Full Tutorial) | Claire Vo](https://creatoreconomy.so/p/from-idea-to-product-in-30min-using-ai-agents-claire-vo): Claire Vo's live tutorial on building features with ChatPRD AI agents
- [Full Tutorial: Build an AI Life Co-Pilot with Claude Code in 25 Minutes | Alex Finn](https://creatoreconomy.so/p/full-tutorial-build-an-ai-life-copilot-with-claude-code-alex-finn): Alex Finn's tutorial on building Claude Life OS for workflow automation
- [Gemini 3.1 + New AI Studio Is Here: Full Prototyping Tutorial in 18 Minutes](https://creatoreconomy.so/p/gemini-3-1-ai-studio-full-prototyping-tutorial): Google's Gemini 3.1 & AI Studio prototyping tutorial with Linear integration
- [I Wrote a PRD with AI and It Worked Surprisingly Well](https://creatoreconomy.so/p/my-prd-template-how-to-write-with-ai): PRD template & AI prompts for product requirements documentation
- [Curious Beginner's Guide to LLMs - by Peter Yang](https://creatoreconomy.so/p/curious-beginners-guide-to-large-language-models): Beginner's guide to LLMs covering neural networks & model training basics

## Product Management & Career Growth

- [My PM Course is Now Open for Enrollment (Upgrade to an Annual Plan to Get 50% Off)](https://creatoreconomy.so/p/my-pm-course-is-now-open-for-enrollment): Maven PM course enrollment with 50% annual discount on product management
- [This Framework Will Change How You Think about Your Career | Shishir Mehrotra (Coda)](https://creatoreconomy.so/p/the-best-framework-for-career-growth-shishir): Coda's Shishir Mehrotra on PSHE framework & YouTube's $1B product growth
- [How the PM Role is Evolving and What You Can Do About It](https://creatoreconomy.so/p/how-product-management-is-evolving): Panel with Coinbase & Duolingo PMs on evolving product management roles
- [5 Practical Steps to Future Proof Your Career in the AI Era](https://creatoreconomy.so/p/5-ways-to-future-proof-your-career-in-the-ai-era): Career strategies for AI era with insights from Replit's Amjad Masad
- [10 Proven Tactics to Influence People and Level Up Your Soft Skills](https://creatoreconomy.so/p/10-tactics-to-influence): Influence tactics from Meta's Satish on leadership & stakeholder management

## Creator Strategy & Business Development

- [How to Craft a Unique Value Prop to Become the Obvious Choice For Your Customer Niche](https://creatoreconomy.so/p/how-to-craft-a-unique-value-prop): 3-step framework for crafting unique value props with examples from James Clear
- [Wes Kao (Co-Founder, Maven): The Dos and Don't of Online Courses](https://creatoreconomy.so/p/wes-kao-dos-donts-online-courses): Maven co-founder Wes Kao on creating $20K+ cohort-based online courses
- [Ammaar Reshi: How to use AI to Create Children's Books, Animated Shorts, and More](https://creatoreconomy.so/p/ammaar-reshi-ai-creation-tools): Step-by-step guide using ChatGPT & Midjourney for AI content creation
- [8 Tips to Manage Your Time Better to Achieve Your Goals in 2024](https://creatoreconomy.so/p/tips-to-manage-your-time-better): Time management strategies using Eisenhower matrix for work-life balance
